mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a shift in consumer spending patterns toward durable goods, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST decline and RSAFS increase fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 110), supply chain disruptions intensify, reducing corporate margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production (INDPRO > 120), supply chain efficiencies improve, increasing corporate margins and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 120.
